data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Demetrios, meaning 'follower of God' or 'devoted to Demeter, the goddess of the harvest'. Demetrio is a popular name in the Christian tradition, particularly for boys, and is associated with saints Demetrius and Demetrios. The name Demetrio carries the meaning “Follower of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Demetrio usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: דמטריו
in_hebrew.meaning: מקור השם דמטריו, קשור לדמטר, אלת החקלאות היוונית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם דמטריו נגזר מהשם היווני דמטריוס (Δημήτριος), שפירושו 'של דמטר' או 'השייך לדמטר'. דמטר היא אלת החקלאות והפריון במיתולוגיה היוונית. השם דמטריו הוא שם נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים, ויש לו קונוטציות של פריון, שגשוג וברכה. השם מופיע גם בברית החדשה, ויש לו היסטוריה ארוכה של שימוש בכנסייה הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Δημήτριος
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Δημήτριος σημαίνει 'του Δήμητρας' ή 'αφιερωμένο στη Δήμητρα'
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Δημήτριος προέρχεται από το όνομα της ελληνικής θεάς Δήμητρας, που ήταν η θεά της γεωργίας και της γονιμότητας. Ο Δημήτριος ήταν ένα κοινό όνομα στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και συνδέθηκε με την έννοια της γονιμότητας και της αφθονίας. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Δημήτριος αναφέρεται ως ένας από τους πρώτους χριστιανούς, και το όνομα έχει μια μακρά ιστορία χρήσης στην Εκκλησία.

in_latin.name: Demetrius
in_latin.meaning: Demetrius means 'of Demeter' or 'dedicated to Demeter'
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Demetrius is derived from the Greek name Δημήτριος (Dēmé́trios), which means 'of Demeter' or 'dedicated to Demeter'. Demeter was the Greek goddess of agriculture and fertility. The name Demetrius has been used in the Christian tradition, particularly in the Eastern Orthodox Church, and has been associated with several saints and martyrs.

in_english.name: Demetrio
in_english.meaning: Demetrio means devoted to Demeter, the Greek goddess of agriculture
in_english.long_meaning: The name Demetrio is derived from the Greek name Δημήτριος (Dēmé́trios), which means 'devoted to Demeter' or 'of Demeter'. The name Demetrio has been used in the Christian tradition, particularly in the Eastern Orthodox Church, and has been associated with several saints and martyrs. The name also holds historical significance, as the Greek origins of Demetrio reflect the interconnectedness of the early Christian and Greek cultures.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Demetrio (as a Christian name) embodies the concept of being devoted to God, and following His teachings. It is a name that signifies faith, spiritual strength, and resilience, reflecting the character displayed by the saints named Demetrius and Demetrios. Wearing this name as an identity evokes the deeper meaning of being a 'follower of God', and reminds the bearer to stay true to their religious or spiritual beliefs. In essence, Demetrio is a name that embodies a deep sense of divine devotion, which resonates strongly with those who value their Christian faith.
